in_sanskrit.name: युव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: युवान् (yuvan) = young, youth; राज (raaj) = king, ruler; युवराज (yuvraaj) = prince, young ruler. Yuv can also mean 'younger brother' in some contexts.

in_hindi.name: युव
in_hindi.long_meaning: युवा (yuvaa) = youth, young man; युवक (yuvak) = young person, youth. Yuv can also mean 'younger brother' in some contexts.

in_telugu.name: యుబ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: యుద్ధ (yuddh) = youth, young man; యుద్ధపు (yuddhupu) = prince, young ruler.

in_marathi.name: Yuv
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yuv means youth and joy in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is a name often given to children, signifying the joy and potential that comes with youth.

in_bengali.name: Yuv
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Youth, Joy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yuv একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Yuv means youth and joy in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is a name often given to children, signifying the joy and potential that comes with youth.
